caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic teapot with a hinged lid that is slightly open. The teapot is rendered in muted shades of gray and brown, giving it an aged, tarnished appearance. It has a curved spout on the left and a large, dark handle on the right, which appears to be made of a different material—possibly wood or a darker metal. The body of the teapot widens toward the base and is decorated with engraved floral and geometric patterns, featuring scalloped borders and stylized motifs on both the upper and lower portions. The teapot is centered on a plain, light background, and there are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Tin Coffee Pot
